reason:
My verdict is keep=false. The fourth pass did what it was asked: it verified, changed no code, and logged its runs and known gaps honestly. The plumbing works. But the looks it would ship still have clear defects beyond the gaps the brief accepts, and they are worst on the pack pair, which the owner wants first. I looked at every image cited below. My frames are in /tmp/claude-0/-home-user-Claude/104ede24-b5bc-5131-bb4c-1bc7e86a4fd2/scratchpad/jdg-castpk4/ (scripts judge.cjs and stage.cjs; logs run-*.log).

WHAT WORKS (all seen in my own frames):
- Menu entry: it reads "Character · Leila Farahani · Irvine".
- Pack shown locked, at 390x844 DPR 3 (viewport-meta copy) and 1450x767: 2 cards marked Locked; the button reads "Chad & Chadaline pack: coming soon, $22.22, 18+" and is disabled; no sideways scroll at 390.
- TEST unlock: gives two TEST chips, "TEST UNLOCK ON · NOT A PURCHASE" and "Drive as Chadaline".
- Venues with Marcus and Leila: the avatar is the chosen character. The crowd is all six (Lot 57: 49 people; Stoppage Time: 73), with notCast 0 and no pack pair.
- Seat view in the Rossini GT, 1280x720 and 390x844 DPR 3: Chad has the black suit cuff with a white shirt sliver; Chadaline has bare forearms, the gold watch and nails; Marcus has his dark tone and short sleeve. driverArms tone matches each character.
- No page errors in any run. No Dodgers, New Era or MLB mark in src. The 01 portrait shows no mark, and the in-game cap shows only the OC mark.
- Frame times look plausible. My run (CDP throttle 4, phone, Chadaline, 30 s) had only 11 frames: p50 750 ms, p95 5983 ms, heap 110.6 MB. That is the same order of magnitude as the builder's SwiftShader tables, but too few frames to resolve the +10% p95 target.
- The 60 s full-lock drive (20 frames, d-chadaline-00..19) showed no clipping, z-fighting or sleeve popping. But at full lock the right arm crosses the hub, and the grey knit 'fur' sleeve covers about a third of the phone screen, including the cluster.

DEFECTS:

Pack pair (the hardest bar):
1. Chad does not read as the sheet's person. The hairline is a hard, notched cut-out with a black rim (pack-chad-head-fx3.png, chad-yaw45-fx3.png). The curls render as a blotchy sponge or rock mass, worse than the recorded "mop". The face is narrow and doll-like, with none of the sheet's strong jaw, heavy brows or stubble.
2. Chadaline's hair has hard, jagged edges:
   - a jagged cut at the centre parting;
   - stringy, black, hard-alpha strands in profile (pack-chadaline-head-fx3.png).
3. Chadaline's shrug back is horizontal bands with dark gaps, so the dress shows through (chadaline-back-fx3.png, pack-chadaline-body-fx3.png). The sheet's shrug is one continuous fur roll, and it reads cream, not grey knit.

The six:
4. Jas's slick black hair and Kate's gold hair still read as helmets (compare-jas-cruz-head-fx3.png, compare-kate-morgan-head-fx3.png); the brief says "no helmets".
5. Danny's hair is split into a hard brown block and a black block, and his open overshirt has ragged white edges at LOD 0 (compare-danny-tran-head-fx3.png).
6. Marcus does not read as muscular in profile: his chest projects like a bust and he has a pot belly. His sandals have ragged black bits (compare-marcus-bell-body-fx3.png). At LOD 2 his legs smear tan into brown (p4/lod2-eight-front-p4.png). These go beyond the recorded "tee width and slim legs".

Third person, the player's own avatar:
7. Leila 2.2 m from the camera in Stoppage Time is drawn with blurred features, and her black top shreds through her blazer in ragged patches (v-stoppage-leila-farahani-front.png; zoom z-leila-stoppage-close.png). This is how the player sees themselves, not a far crowd.
8. People in the crowd 2.6 m away are faceless blurs (v-stoppage-marcus-bell-crowd.png), so the six don't read as themselves in crowds.

Picker turntable (PLAUSIBLE, not reproduced):
9. At 390x844 DPR 3, one frame showed Leila's face covered by hair with see-through holes and her teeth showing (p-picker-390x844.png; zoom z-picker-leila-head.png). Four turning grabs and a reduced-motion still did not reproduce it, so it may depend on the angle or be a hair-sorting fault.

Evidence gaps:
- The builder's venue frames for the pack pair are night frames (the venue clock is 19:30). pack-venue-stoppage-chadaline-front.png shows no character at all. The cast-pack-venues PASS rests on hook values, not on anything visible.
- Every suite group passing confirms behaviour; it does not show the looks meet the brief.

No non-cast person got worse: preset-casual-before-after-fx3.png is unchanged or slightly better.
fixes: Chad: replace the hard notched hairline with a soft-edged hairline (alpha-to-coverage or a feathered card fringe over the forehead, no black rim). Rebuild the curls as visible ringlet clumps, not a sponge-textured mass. Widen and square the jaw, thicken the brows and add the sheet's light stubble at LOD 0. Re-shoot pack-chad-head/body beside the sheet.

Chadaline: soften the centre-parting edge (no jagged cut-out, no skin-coloured notch). Replace the hard black strand edges in profile with feathered cards. Make the shrug back one continuous cream fur roll with no dark gaps between the bands. Re-shoot front, side and back beside the sheet.

Venue avatar: in third person within about 4 m, draw the player's own character at LOD 0, or fix LOD 1's open outer layers so the inner top doesn't shred through the jacket and blazer. Re-shoot Leila and Chad up close in both venues in daylight (set the venue clock to day, so frames are not unreadable night shots).

Picker turntable: reproduce Leila at the front-on angle at 390x844 DPR 3. Grab the canvas every 1-2 s for a full turn and find the angle where the hair covers the face with see-through holes and the teeth show (hair transparency sort or depthWrite). Fix it, and add a regression grab of the front-on turntable.

Jas and Kate: break up the helmet silhouettes. Add a lifted crown and loose strands at the temples (Jas: a high, voluminous ponytail; Kate: a messy low ponytail with face-framing wisps), as the brief's 'no helmets' requires.
Danny: remove the hard two-tone split in the hair. Fix the ragged white edge of the open overshirt at LOD 0.
Marcus: reshape the chest so the profile reads as pectoral muscle, not a bust, and flatten the belly. Fix the ragged black bits on the sandals and the colour smear down the legs at LOD 2.
Crowds: draw people within about 3 m at LOD 1 or better, so the six read as themselves at the bar, not as faceless blurs.

Phone seat view at full lock: reduce how much of the screen Chadaline's sleeve covers (shorter or slimmer 3/4 fur sleeve, cream like the sheet). Coordinate with the hands owner on the arm crossing the hub.
